description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'SlidingTabsBasicFragment' that demonstrates how to set up a ViewPager with a custom SlidingTabLayout to display tabs with continuous feedback. It includes a nested PagerAdapter class 'SamplePagerAdapter' that provides pages and tab titles.

classes.name: SlidingTabsBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment demonstrating usage of a ViewPager with sliding tabs, including an internal PagerAdapter class.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the ViewPager with its adapter and links it to the SlidingTabLayout.
